## Summary
- Implemented `CardBrowser` React component that fetches the catalog from `GET /api/cards`.
- Styled the UI using vanilla CSS with glassmorphism and nearest-neighbor scaling (`image-rendering: pixelated`) for card images per the MVP design aesthetic.
- Implemented client-side sorting (by name, id, and type) and filtering functionalities.
- Wired the card browser into `client/src/App.tsx` as a pop-out panel over the Konva stage.
- Updated `client/vite.config.ts` to proxy `/api` traffic to the backend server to resolve CORS and hardcoded URL issues.

Implements Unit 4 of [planning/mvp-work-breakdown.md](planning/mvp-work-breakdown.md).

## Test plan
- [x] `npm run typecheck` passes successfully.
- [x] Manual: verified the UI lists all sample cards, sorting/filtering works instantly on the client side, and images are correctly upscaled.
